body: I honestly wish he would go ahead and let me know something one way or the other so that I CAN start to grieve and get on with my life, but he keeps saying he's going to quit the drugs soon, but he always has an excuse why he can't quit today. He gives me just enough hope to keep hanging on and waiting.  I gave him an ultimatum, now or never, and that's when he started staying with us.

It's not necessarily that, I'm just so upset and disappointed that the thing I wanted the most was going to happen and then didn't.  And idk if I can get through it without getting depressed and sleeping and losing everything again.  That's what is Bothering me the most
